resources.string: Maintains an overlay view for screen dimming and blue light filtering to reduce eye strain during night use.
The filter is off, but the accessibility service is still running in the background.

Nyx requires Accessibility permissions to apply the screen filter over the entire system, including the navigation bar and lock screen.\n\nTap the button below, find Nyx in the list and turn the service on.
If Nyx is greyed out in that list (Android 13+, installed outside the Play Store): open App info, tap the three-dot menu and choose Allow restricted settings, then try again.
Higher values keep more warmth at the cost of lifted blacks (less OLED-friendly).
